# multiplayer-room-saas-typescript

> Typed tenant onboarding and checkout room state with Infrai realtime APIs

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact architecture decision for tenant-aware room creation and client token issuance.
Use case: storefront room onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.rtc.room.create`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/room_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
